"""Read-only observer for the one retained GET-repair deployment request."""
import json,subprocess,re,urllib.request,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
if not __debug__:raise RuntimeError('Optimized execution refused')
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
admission=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json')
intent=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-requested.json')
reply=read('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-response.json')
assert not reply.get('errors') and isinstance(reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'],str)
deployment=reply['data']['serviceInstanceDeployV2'];commit=admission['commit']
assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}',commit) and intent['commit']==commit
assert intent['admissionSha256']==hashlib.sha256(Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-admission.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
cli=['C:/Users/nimab/.bun/bin/bunx.exe','@railway/cli']
raw=subprocess.check_output(cli+['deployment','list','--project','119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa','--service','f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db','--environment','6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28','--json'],timeout=90)
rows=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'));row=next(r for r in rows if r['id']==deployment)
progress={'observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'deploymentId':deployment,'status':row['status'],'commit':row.get('meta',{}).get('commitHash')}
Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-recovery2-runtime-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(progress,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
if row['status']!='SUCCESS':
 print(json.dumps(progress));raise SystemExit(0)
assert row['meta']['commitHash']==commit and re.fullmatch('sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}',row['meta']['imageDigest'])
assert not any(r['id']!=deployment and r['status'] not in ('REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED') for r in rows)
auto=Path('.superpowers/m78-auto-status.graphql');assert auto.read_text().strip()=='query { serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus(environmentId:"6642d65a-15a2-41e9-b25e-b7b01990aa28",projectId:"119f3652-9d84-4d16-983c-1a17c0fd1aaa",serviceId:"f43abcf9-72f0-4034-828a-8d83ca26b0db") { enabled } }'
a=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cli+['api','--file',str(auto),'--compact'],timeout=90));assert not a.get('errors') and a['data']['serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus']['enabled'] is False
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=30) as response:
 assert response.status==200
 ready=json.load(response)
assert ready=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
result={'status':'m78_get_route_deployed_runtime_verified','observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'deploymentId':deployment,'commit':commit,'imageDigest':row['meta']['imageDigest'],'deploymentStatus':'SUCCESS','httpStatus':200,'ready':ready,'autodeploy':False,'admissionSha256':intent['admissionSha256'],'requestIntentSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-deployment-requested.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'deploymentCollectionSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'deploymentCollectionPath':'.superpowers/m78-get-route-recovery2-runtime-collection.json','recoveryExecuted':False,'restartExecuted':False,'revisitExecuted':False}
with Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-recovery2-runtime-collection.json').open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
with Path('.superpowers/m78-get-route-recovery2-runtime-verified.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

# M78 read-only recovery 2 admission review

## Verdict

Pass for the exact root-authored finalizer, source-closure collector and runtime observer listed in the receipt. The source closure also binds the local-only evaluator. This is a source and mocked-filesystem verdict; no finalizer, runtime observer, credential, provider call, database operation, Git mutation or recovery was executed.

The finalizer binds the exact accepted root source review, independent private-helper review, corrected failure review, failed recovery journals, 173-file historical inventory with only the accepted route replacement, and fresh deployed runtime identity. It rehashes the complete 182-file closure before writing an exclusive source gate and execution admission. Every recovery-2 evidence path, durable lock and both gate paths must be absent first.

The fixed-clock harness executes the actual finalizer source with only the clock replaced. Its positive in-memory case emits exactly two gates containing 182 source pins and 189 unique execution pins. Twenty-one adversarial cases refuse before any write: stale or altered runtime fields, changed source/review/failure evidence, an open root finding, each existing output/lock/gate, and omitted, duplicated or changed closure pins.

The runtime observer is byte-identical to the previously accepted read-only observer except for its three recovery-2 output names. It retains the deployment collection before emitting an exclusive verified receipt and performs only deployment-list, service-status and readiness reads. The closure performs static TypeScript import discovery and includes the observer, entry, wrapper, closure, local evaluator, public evaluator and runner. The local evaluator reads retained files and uses one exclusive local result path; it has no authentication, network or child-process path.

## Review history and limits

First review found that the observer was not explicitly required by the closure. Root added the observer and local evaluator, raised the minimum closure to 182 files and pinned the observer hash in the finalizer. The repaired sources passed the targeted suite.

This receipt does not establish a fresh runtime observation, execute either gate writer, decrypt configuration, authenticate, call the hosted service, accept recovery output, or authorize restart or revisit. Runtime freshness and every current byte must still pass when root runs the finalizer.
